caption: The drawing depicts a single metal coffee pot with a tall, conical body, a long curved spout on the left, and a looped handle on the right. The pot is primarily a dark brown color and is decorated with painted floral patterns. These patterns consist of large, stylized flowers and leaves in shades of red, yellow, blue, and green, arranged in a band around the middle section and also appearing on the spout and lid. The lid is dome-shaped and has a small knob at the top, featuring a repeating design of yellow and green shapes. A repeating band of yellow oval shapes outlines the edge of the lid, the top of the pot, and the base. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color with no additional objects or patterns visible.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
